title: Video by curiousrefuge
description:
🏆 Huge congrats to Sasha Fevralskaya for taking first place in our 2026 AI Horror Film Competition with Kagome!

What an incredible film! The cinematography, the pacing, the way it builds suspense… there’s so much to appreciate here. It’s so rich and layered!

One of our judges even called it “an incredible display of craft” and said it’s a film every aspiring AI filmmaker should watch. We couldn’t agree more!

Also, shout out to our judges @theblasian, @shelbyward, @verenapuhm, @xmister_whitex, and @verenapuhm for taking the time to watch all the films and share their thoughtful feedback. We really appreciate you all! ❤️

#aifilm #aihorror #aivideo #aifilmmaking #aishort
